Wind of change

Art universities as active contributors or neutral ground?

Date
16 May 2024
Time
16:00–17:30 CEST
Location
Moholy-Nagy University of Art and Design
Zugligeti út 9, 1121 Budapest, Hungary
Format
Onsite discussion & workshop
Conference
P/References of Design
Cumulus Budapest 2024

The university and society

This session considered how art and design universities participate in society through education, advocacy, research and public engagement. It asked how academic freedom, ethical practice and social responsibility shape a sustainable environment for students and academics — and what these commitments mean for higher education pedagogy.

The discussion took place in person, without an online broadcast.

Session contributors

Andreas Kohli, a lecturer at Zurich University of the Arts, brought interests in arts education, ecology, interculturality and teaching resources. Minna Suoniemi, an artist, curator and Aalto University Lecturer, brought a practice informed by embodied experience and feminist knowledge production.
